title: Taco Sorceress
description: A green-skinned witch with flowing multicolored hair sits at a round table casting spells on a towering stack of dripping tacos. Behind her a massive stained-glass Zodiac wheel floats in a stormy sky, surrounded by floating witches emitting beams of light toward the enchanted feast.
prompt: A green-skinned female witch with long flowing rainbow hair sits at a round table covered in papers and hot sauce bottles, grinning as she magically prepares a giant stack of dripping tacos with melting cheese and colorful shells. Behind her a large circular stained-glass Zodiac wheel glows in a dark stormy sky while multiple robed witches float around it casting beams of light, red lanterns and lightning in the background, highly detailed fantasy illustration
